question: CO2 lever of another air flow / supply temperature at plant A (steam + fans)
caveat: proxy constraints do not replace a product-moisture measurement; the result is an upper bound of the lever, not an operating recommendation; all non-measured inputs are placeholders

dryer.solid_fraction.source: not measured. Lower end from the dryer energy balance itself (heat-loss conductance >= 0 needs >= 0.59 / 0.63 on product 1 / 2); a suspension density of 1339 kg/m3 (control-system screenshot, a third date, product unknown) corresponds to 0.42-0.76 for a solid density of 2500-1500 kg/m3; feeds of fluidised-bed spray granulation are typically concentrated suspensions (order 0.4-0.7, textbook order of magnitude, no specific source). Same value for both products (assumption).

dryer.intake_relative_humidity.source: not measured; same assumption as the storage model (Befund 91)

dryer.feed_temperature_celsius.source: not measured; temperature of the sprayed suspension

dryer.atomising_air_temperature_celsius.source: not measured; compressed atomising air after its cooler

dryer.room_temperature_celsius.source: not measured; reference of the dryer heat loss (hall)

dryer.cp_solid_j_per_kg_k.source: default of MaterialConfig, no source for these products

dryer.normal_density_kg_per_nm3.source: textbook value; moist-air correction neglected (as storage_a1)

energy.fan_heat_fraction.source: share of the process-fan power that heats the supply air (storage_a1)

energy.boiler_efficiency.source: steam from a gas boiler; band of the task, no plant value

energy.electricity_co2_kg_per_kwh.source: project factor of carrier_energy (base); 0.20 is a 2030 placeholder without source

energy.max_preheater_water_celsius.source: only in the variant duty_held: highest water inlet of the preheater (compressor heat at about 85 degC minus an exchanger approach; Befund 99 used 85 -> 45 degC)

fan.law.source: the data hold almost no variation of the air flow (within-day CV below 0.3 %); the only lever is the difference between the two days, confounded with the product

constraint.air_fraction_min.source: placeholder for the fluidisation limit (minimum air flow / today's)
